path.description: one of segment[[r,z],[r,z]], polyline{points,closed}, rect{r,z,fillet}, arc{center,radius,angles}

domain_solid.description: 3D: box, cylinder, sphere, torus, cone, revolve{profile,angles}, extrude, step, union, difference, intersection, imported (mesh.file); optional rotate/translate

refinements.description: uniform refinements of the generated mesh; the parser refuses them with mesh.adapt

enabled.description: the region exists only if this evaluates to nonzero

shape.description: one of rect{r,z,fillet}, frame{r,z,thickness,fillet}, polygon{points,fillet,fillets} (points are [r,z] or [r,z,fillet]; 'fillets' is a parallel list of per-vertex radii), contour{start,segments: [{line:[r,z]} | {ellipse:{center,axes,t}}]} (exact elliptical arcs), disk{center,radius}, union[shapes], difference[shapes], imported{} (2D imported meshes, mesh.file); cross-section (xsec) designs: (x, y) coordinates, rect{x,y}, disk{pivot,arm,angle_deg,radius}

solid.description: 3D: box, cylinder, sphere, torus, cone, revolve{profile,angles}, extrude, step, union, difference, intersection, imported (mesh.file); optional rotate/translate
